paper_title: Expanding Chemical Space in the Synthesis of Gold Bipyramids (Sánchez-Iglesias & Grzelczak, Small 2024, DOI: 10.1002/smll.202407735)

experimental_series_ground_truth.title: Single-Surfactant Baseline Comparison: Pure CTAB (100 mM) vs. Pure CTAC (100 mM)
experimental_series_ground_truth.baseline_and_perturbation: Using thermally treated pentatwinned Au seeds (6 nm, CTAC/citric acid aged at 80 °C for 90 min), compare growth at 35 °C with [HAuCl4]=0.25 mM, [AgNO3]=30 µM, [8-HQL]=3.7 mM, and [HAuCl4]/[Au0]=67 in (A) Pure CTAB (100 mM, no CTAC) vs. (B) Pure CTAC (100 mM, no CTAB).
experimental_series_ground_truth.ground_truth_summary: Pure CTAB (100 mM) yields short, low-aspect-ratio rice-like bipyramids (LSPR ~575 nm) with high shape purity (minimal spheres), whereas Pure CTAC (100 mM) yields high-aspect-ratio elongated bipyramids (LSPR ~950 nm) alongside a large fraction of isotropic spherical byproducts (strong 525 nm peak).

ground_truth_metrics.LSPR_wavelength: Pure CTAB: ~575 nm (short rice-like) vs. Pure CTAC: bimodal 525 nm (spheres) + ~950 nm (elongated AuBPs)
ground_truth_metrics.Aspect_ratio: Pure CTAB: low AR (~1.6-1.8, rice-like) vs. Pure CTAC: high AR (~4.5-5.5)
ground_truth_metrics.Shape_purity_yield: Pure CTAB: high purity rice-like bipyramids; Pure CTAC: poor purity (heavy isotropic sphere contamination)

experimental_series_ground_truth.title: Binary Surfactant [CTAB] Sweep (1 to 50 mM) in 100 mM CTAC at [HAuCl4]/[Au0] = 67 (13 Samples)
experimental_series_ground_truth.paper_reference: Figure 1a,c-i, Table S1, Figures S2, S3, S5
experimental_series_ground_truth.baseline_and_perturbation: In 100 mM CTAC growth solution at 35 °C ([HAuCl4]=0.25 mM, [AgNO3]=30 µM, [8-HQL], [HAuCl4]/[Au0]=67, [Au0]=3.75 µM), systematically increase [CTAB] across 13 samples: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 10, 14, 18, 25, 35, 40, 50 mM.
experimental_series_ground_truth.ground_truth_summary: Increasing [CTAB] from 1 mM to 50 mM monotonically blueshifts LSPR from 1070 nm to 584 nm, decreases length L from 100±3 nm to 49±4 nm, increases width W from 17±1 nm to 29±1 nm, decreases aspect ratio AR from 5.9±0.4 to 1.7±0.1, increases tip radius from ~1.8 nm to ~6.5 nm, and slows reaction completion time from 30 min to 350 min, while single-particle volume remains invariant at ~11,000 nm³.

ground_truth_metrics.LSPR_wavelength: decrease (blueshifts 486 nm: 1070 nm at 1 mM -> 882 nm at 5 mM -> 806 nm at 10 mM -> 682 nm at 25 mM -> 584 nm at 50 mM)
ground_truth_metrics.Particle_length: decrease (100±3 nm at 1 mM -> 86±2 nm at 5 mM -> 78±1 nm at 10 mM -> 64±2 nm at 25 mM -> 49±4 nm at 50 mM)
ground_truth_metrics.Particle_width: increase (17±1 nm at 1 mM -> 21±1 nm at 5 mM -> 23±1 nm at 10 mM -> 26±1 nm at 25 mM -> 29±1 nm at 50 mM)
ground_truth_metrics.Single_particle_volume: no_significant_change (invariant at ~11,000 nm³ across all 13 samples)
ground_truth_metrics.Reaction_completion_time: increase (30 min at 1-3 mM -> 60 min at 10 mM -> 120 min at 25 mM -> 350 min at 50 mM)
ground_truth_metrics.Tip_radius: increase (tips become progressively rounder/blunter from ~1.8 nm to ~6.5 nm, wedge angle drops linearly)

experimental_series_ground_truth.title: Counterion Decoupling: Inorganic [KBr] Sweep (1 to 50 mM) in 100 mM CTAC (Zero CTAB, 7 Samples)
experimental_series_ground_truth.paper_reference: Table S2 & Figure S4 ( plus Figure S6 UV-Vis [AuCl4]- -> [AuBr4]- titration)
experimental_series_ground_truth.baseline_and_perturbation: Replace CTAB completely with inorganic potassium bromide (KBr: 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 35, 50 mM) in 100 mM CTAC at [HAuCl4]/[Au0] = 67 ([Au0]=3.75 µM, [AgNO3]=30 µM, 35 °C). Also evaluate the UV-Vis ligand exchange of 0.25 mM HAuCl4 in 100 mM CTAC upon adding 1-100 mM Br-.
experimental_series_ground_truth.ground_truth_summary: Replacing CTAB with KBr (1 to 50 mM) reproduces virtually identical dimensions, optical shifts, and reaction times as CTAB: LSPR blueshifts from 1032 nm (1 mM KBr) to 583 nm (50 mM KBr), L drops from 103±1 nm to 49±3 nm, W increases from 19±1 nm to 29±2 nm, AR drops from 5.4±0.3 to 1.7±0.1, and completion time slows from 30 min to 350 min. UV-Vis titration shows CTA+/[AuCl4]- (315 nm) converts to CTA+/[AuBr4]- (390 nm) with a plateau at 18 mM Br-.

ground_truth_metrics.LSPR_wavelength: decrease (1032 nm at 1 mM KBr -> 907 nm at 5 mM -> 797 nm at 10 mM -> 688 nm at 25 mM -> 583 nm at 50 mM KBr)
ground_truth_metrics.Single_particle_volume: no_significant_change (invariant ~11,000 nm³, identical to CTAB series)
ground_truth_metrics.Reaction_completion_time: increase (30 min at 1-2 mM -> 60 min at 10 mM -> 120 min at 25 mM -> 350 min at 50 mM)

experimental_series_ground_truth.title: Silver Nitrate [AgNO3] Concentration Sweep (0 to 100 µM) at Fixed [CTAC]=100 mM, [CTAB]=5 mM, [Au3+]/[Au0]=20 (8 Samples)
experimental_series_ground_truth.baseline_and_perturbation: In [CTAC]=100 mM and [CTAB]=5 mM with [Au0]=12.5 µM ([HAuCl4]/[Au0]=20) at 35 °C for 30 min, vary [AgNO3] across 8 samples: 0, 15, 17, 19, 23, 30, 40, and 100 µM.
experimental_series_ground_truth.ground_truth_summary: Contrary to single-crystal Au nanorods where [Ag+] continuously increases aspect ratio, in pentatwinned AuBPs [AgNO3] acts as a threshold switch for yield with minimal effect on dimensions above 30 µM: At 0 µM AgNO3, 100% isotropic spheres form (LSPR 527 nm). From 15 to 30 µM AgNO3, bipyramid population rises from ~35% to 98% and LSPR redshifts from 625 nm to 737 nm. From 30 µM to 100 µM AgNO3 (once >=1 monolayer of Ag atoms, ~1290 Ag/100 nm², covers the surface), purity stays ~98%, length stays constant within error (48±2 to 49±2 nm), width stays constant (16±1 nm), AR stays constant (3.0±0.1 to 3.1±0.2), and LSPR shifts by only 16 nm (737 to 753 nm).

ground_truth_metrics.Shape_purity_yield: non_monotonic_threshold (0% AuBPs / 100% spheres at 0 µM -> rises steeply across 15-23 µM -> saturates at >=98% AuBP purity for 30-100 µM)
ground_truth_metrics.LSPR_wavelength: non_monotonic_threshold (527 nm at 0 µM -> redshifts to 737 nm at 30 µM -> plateaus at 737-753 nm from 30 to 100 µM)
ground_truth_metrics.Aspect_ratio_and_dimensions_above_thresh: no_significant_change (for 30-100 µM Ag+, L=48±2 to 49±2 nm, W=16±1 nm, AR=3.0±0.1 to 3.1±0.2)

experimental_series_ground_truth.title: Seed Concentration [Au0] Sweep (2.5 to 25 µM; [HAuCl4]/[Au0] from 100 down to 10) at Constant [CTAB]=5 mM (8 Samples)
experimental_series_ground_truth.baseline_and_perturbation: At constant [CTAC]=100 mM, [CTAB]=5 mM, [HAuCl4]=0.25 mM, [AgNO3]=30 µM, and t=30 min at 35 °C, increase thermally aged seed concentration [Au0] across 8 samples: 2.5, 3.8, 5.0, 6.3, 8.3, 12.5, 18.8, and 25.0 µM (corresponding to [HAuCl4]/[Au0] molar ratios of 100, 67, 50, 40, 30, 20, 13, and 10).
experimental_series_ground_truth.ground_truth_summary: Increasing seed concentration from 2.5 to 25.0 µM progressively reduces single-particle volume from ~14,000 nm³ down to ~2,300 nm³ (ultra-small minibipyramids at 25 µM with 90% yield), while simultaneously decreasing length L from 105±3 nm to 32±2 nm, decreasing width W from 22±1 nm to 14±1 nm, decreasing aspect ratio AR from 4.7±0.2 to 2.2±0.1, and blueshifting LSPR from 976 nm to 635 nm.

ground_truth_metrics.Single_particle_volume: decrease (drops ~6-fold from ~14,000 nm³ at 2.5 µM seeds down to ~2,300 nm³ at 25 µM seeds)
ground_truth_metrics.Particle_length: decrease (105±3 nm at 2.5 µM -> 73±3 nm at 5.0 µM -> 46±2 nm at 12.5 µM -> 32±2 nm at 25.0 µM)
ground_truth_metrics.Particle_width: decrease (22±1 nm at 2.5 µM -> 20±1 nm at 5.0 µM -> 16±1 nm at 12.5 µM -> 14±1 nm at 25.0 µM)
ground_truth_metrics.LSPR_wavelength: decrease (blueshifts from 976 nm -> 842 nm -> 729 nm -> 635 nm)

experimental_series_ground_truth.title: 2D Co-Perturbation of [CTAB] x [Seeds] for Iso-LSPR (750 nm & 800 nm) Volume Tuning (3,110 to 19,702 nm³) & Optical Sensitivity (RIS/FOM)
experimental_series_ground_truth.paper_reference: Figure 3e, Figure 5a-d, Tables S5-S6, Figures S9-S10, S13-S17
experimental_series_ground_truth.baseline_and_perturbation: Part A: Sweep [CTAB] from 1 to 25 mM at lower [HAuCl4]/[Au0] ratios of 50 ([Au0]=5.0 µM, Table S5) and 30 ([Au0]=8.25 µM, Table S6). Part B: Simultaneously co-vary seed concentration [Au0] and [CTAB] to hold longitudinal LSPR strictly constant at ~750 nm (or ~800 nm) while varying particle volume 6-fold from 3,110 nm³ to 19,702 nm³, and measure Refractive Index Sensitivity (RIS) and Figure of Merit (FOM) in water-glycerol mixtures.
experimental_series_ground_truth.ground_truth_summary: At [HAuCl4]/[Au0]=50 (Table S5), increasing [CTAB] 1->25 mM blueshifts LSPR from 1030 to 679 nm (L: 100->58 nm, W: 19->23 nm, AR: 5.2->2.5). At [HAuCl4]/[Au0]=30 (Table S6), increasing [CTAB] 1->25 mM blueshifts LSPR from 905 to 631 nm (L: 76->48 nm, W: 17->20 nm, AR: 4.4->2.4). By pairing higher seed concentration (smaller V, lower AR) with lower [CTAB] (higher AR at fixed V), 6 samples with identical LSPR (~750 nm, AR ~3.6) are synthesized spanning a 6-fold volume range (3,110 to 19,702 nm³; L from 35 to 80 nm, W from 15 to 27 nm). At constant LSPR (~800 nm, AR=3.6), increasing volume from 3,181 to 11,160 nm³ increases RIS from 381 to 408 nm/RIU, narrows FWHM from 73.7 to 64.5 nm, and increases FOM from 5.2 to 6.3.

ground_truth_metrics.LSPR_vs_CTAB_at_ratios_30_and_50: decrease (1030->679 nm at ratio 50; 905->631 nm at ratio 30)
ground_truth_metrics.Iso_LSPR_volume_tuning: increase (6-fold volume expansion from 3,110 to 19,702 nm³ achieved at constant LSPR=750 nm by decreasing [Au0] while increasing [CTAB])
ground_truth_metrics.Refractive_Index_Sensitivity_and_FOM_vs_: increase (as V increases from 3,181 to 11,160 nm³ at AR=3.6, RIS increases 381->408 nm/RIU, FWHM drops 73.7->64.5 nm, FOM increases 5.2->6.3)

experimental_series_ground_truth.title: Secondary Overgrowth of Pre-Synthesized AuBPs (66 x 19 nm) as a Function of [CTAB] (2 to 50 mM) at [HAuCl4]/[Au0] = 5 (8 Samples)
experimental_series_ground_truth.baseline_and_perturbation: Use pre-synthesized AuBPs (L=66 nm, W=19 nm, AR=3.5, LSPR=795 nm) as seeds ([Au0]=5.0 µM, [HAuCl4]/[Au0]=5) in [CTAC]=100 mM, [AgNO3]=30 µM, and 8-HQL at 35 °C. Vary [CTAB] across 8 overgrowth samples: 2, 5, 8, 10, 18, 25, 38, and 50 mM.
experimental_series_ground_truth.ground_truth_summary: Overgrowth conserves the bipyramidal morphology while scaling particles to larger dimensions. Increasing [CTAB] from 2 mM to 50 mM slows overgrowth time from 30 min to 350 min, decreases final overgrown length from 173±4 nm to 76±1 nm, increases final width from 27±2 nm to 36±1 nm, decreases aspect ratio from 6.4±0.5 to 2.2±0.1, and blueshifts LSPR from 1274 nm (at 2 mM) to 662 nm (at 50 mM). Crucially, at the lowest CTAB concentration (2 mM, CTAC:CTAB = 50:1), minimal CTA+/[AgBr2]- tip protection leads to rapid gold deposition on the tips, forming dumbbell-like / spherical-tipped bipyramids.

ground_truth_metrics.LSPR_wavelength: decrease (blueshifts from 1274 nm at 2 mM CTAB -> 940 nm at 10 mM -> 798 nm at 25 mM -> 662 nm at 50 mM CTAB)
ground_truth_metrics.Particle_length: decrease (173±4 nm at 2 mM -> 154±2 nm at 5 mM -> 130±1 nm at 10 mM -> 108±1 nm at 25 mM -> 76±1 nm at 50 mM)
ground_truth_metrics.Particle_width: increase (27±2 nm at 2 mM -> 30±1 nm at 5 mM -> 32±1 nm at 10 mM -> 34±1 nm at 25 mM -> 36±1 nm at 50 mM)
ground_truth_metrics.Low_CTAB_2mM_tip_morphology: increase (at 2 mM CTAB, selective tip overgrowth produces spherical/dumbbell-like tips)

experimental_series_ground_truth.title: 30-Day Long-Term Storage & Reshaping Stability of AuBPs (Initial LSPR = 900 nm) in 10 mM CTAB vs. 10 mM CTAC at 27 °C
experimental_series_ground_truth.baseline_and_perturbation: Take identical as-prepared AuBPs (initial LSPR = 900 nm, L ≈ 76 nm, W ≈ 20 nm, AR = 3.8±0.1, tip radius = 3.0±0.4 nm), centrifuge and redisperse into either (A) pure 10 mM CTAB or (B) pure 10 mM CTAC, and store at 27 °C for 30 days.
experimental_series_ground_truth.ground_truth_summary: After 30 days at 27 °C, AuBPs stored in 10 mM CTAB exhibit a pronounced 45 nm LSPR blueshift (from 900 nm down to 855 nm) due to tip rounding/blunting (tip radius increases from 3.0±0.4 nm to 3.7±0.4 nm while overall aspect ratio remains ~3.8±0.1), driven by the lower redox potential of AuBr2- (0.960 V) vs AuCl2- (1.154 V) facilitating surface atom migration/oxidation at sharp tips. In contrast, AuBPs stored in 10 mM CTAC show zero LSPR shift (remains at 900 nm for 30 days) and preserve sharp tips (r_tip = 3.0±0.4 nm).

ground_truth_metrics.LSPR_shift_in_CTAB_30_days: decrease (blueshifts by 45 nm from 900 nm to 855 nm over 30 days)
ground_truth_metrics.LSPR_shift_in_CTAC_30_days: no_significant_change (remains constant at 900 nm over 30 days)
ground_truth_metrics.Tip_radius_in_CTAB_vs_CTAC: increase (tip radius increases by 0.7 nm in CTAB from 3.0±0.4 nm to 3.7±0.4 nm; unchanged in CTAC)

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Pure CTAB yields elongated Au bipyramids with longitudinal LSPR in the near-infrared, whereas pure CTAC yields predominantly isotropic/quasi-spherical particles with LSPR in the visible region due to lack of facet-stabilizing bromide ions.

observables.mechanistic_justification: Bromide ions from CTAB selectively bind to Au facets to direct anisotropic growth along the longitudinal axis. In pure CTAC, the weaker binding chloride fails to break symmetry, leading to isotropic growth.
CTAB provides the halide-assisted underpotential deposition environment required to maintain pentatwinned anisotropic tip-directed growth, while pure CTAC drives uniform radial growth.
Without bromide counterions, twinned seed elongation is suppressed, resulting in irregular spherical byproduct dominance.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Increasing [CTAB] from 1 to 50 mM in 100 mM CTAC slows reduction kinetics and shifts growth from tip-preferential to lateral, systematically decreasing aspect ratio, blue-shifting the longitudinal LSPR, and increasing tip radius.

observables.mechanistic_justification: Progressive displacement of Cl- by Br- modulates the facet capping ratio and slows Au reduction, promoting lateral deposition and lowering aspect ratio.
High [Br-] retards tip growth kinetics via stronger surface passivation and slower reduction of AuBr4- compared to AuCl4-.
Slower longitudinal growth redirects adatom flux toward lateral equatorial facets.
Simultaneous length contraction and width expansion monotonically reduce the aspect ratio.
Total precursor [HAuCl4] and seed concentration are constant; all available Au(III) is fully reduced into the fixed number of seeds.
Formation of AuBr4- complexes with lower reduction potentials and denser surfactant packing substantially slows the reduction rate by 8-HQL.
Higher bromide concentrations passivate sharp tips and promote rounded, blunter apexes.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Adding inorganic KBr to 100 mM CTAC quantitatively replicates the CTAB sweep: UV-Vis shows rapid Cl- to Br- ligand exchange on Au(III), and resulting AuBPs show identical aspect ratio reduction and reaction deceleration.

observables.mechanistic_justification: The bromide counterion alone, rather than the CTA+ cation concentration, governs facet binding and the Au(III) coordination sphere.
Free Br- from KBr coordinates to Au(III) and the micellar Stern layer, driving lateral growth exactly like CTAB.
Constant seed and metal precursor concentrations maintain constant average mass per particle.
Coordination of Br- shifts the Au(III)/Au(0) redox potential negatively, decelerating reduction kinetics identically to CTAB.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Silver nitrate exhibits a sharp threshold behavior: below ~17-19 µM AgNO3, bipyramid yield is negligible; above this threshold, shape purity jumps to >85% and dimensions stabilize.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: < 10% at 0-15 µM; jumps to 85 - 95% at >= 19 µM
observables.mechanistic_justification: A critical concentration of Ag+ is necessary to trigger underpotential deposition (UPD) on high-index side facets, stabilizing pentatwinned bipyramidal growth.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: 530 nm (at 0 µM) jumping to 740 - 780 nm (at >= 19 µM)
observables.mechanistic_justification: Transition from isotropic spheres/aggregates to high aspect ratio bipyramids shifts the dipolar plasmon band into the NIR.
Once UPD monolayer coverage is achieved to direct anisotropic growth, excess Ag+ provides minimal additional morphological alteration.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Increasing seed concentration at fixed [HAuCl4] distributes the same gold precursor over a larger particle population, systematically reducing particle volume and dimensions while aspect ratio and LSPR exhibit mild blue-shifts.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: 20,000 nm³ down to 2,500 nm³ (inversely proportional to [Au0])
observables.mechanistic_justification: The fixed quantity of Au3+ precursor is divided among an increasing number of seed nuclei.
Reduced gold atom availability per seed restricts overall linear expansion.
Equatorial facet growth scales down proportionally with the lower available Au mass.
Growth kinetics slightly favor radial completion as particle size decreases toward the seed regime.
Combined decrease in aspect ratio and increased electrodynamic depolarization in smaller particles shift the resonance blue.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Co-varying seed concentration and [CTAB] enables independent volume scaling at fixed LSPR; larger volume AuBPs exhibit higher Refractive Index Sensitivity (RIS) and Figure of Merit (FOM).

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: Blueshifts by ~150 - 250 nm across 1 to 25 mM CTAB
observables.mechanistic_justification: Higher CTAB concentrations suppress aspect ratio consistently across lower precursor-to-seed ratios.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: LSPR held at 750 ± 15 nm or 800 ± 15 nm while volume spans 3,110 to 19,702 nm³
observables.mechanistic_justification: Compensating [Au0] increases with reduced [CTAB] preserves aspect ratio while varying particle mass.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: RIS: 220 up to 550 nm/RIU; FOM increases from 1.5 to 3.8
observables.mechanistic_justification: Higher single-particle volume enhances polarizability and plasmonic scattering cross-section, increasing sensitivity to local dielectric changes.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Secondary overgrowth of pre-formed AuBPs at [HAuCl4]/[Au0]=5 depends strongly on [CTAB]: low [CTAB] drives apex deposition with red-shifted LSPR, while high [CTAB] drives lateral overgrowth, causing a net blue-shift.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: 860 nm (at 2 mM CTAB) down to 730 nm (at 50 mM CTAB)
observables.mechanistic_justification: Low [Br-] directs Au deposition exclusively to high-energy tips (aspect ratio increases), whereas high [Br-] promotes side-wall deposition (aspect ratio decreases).

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: 82 nm (at 2 mM) down to 68 nm (at 50 mM)
observables.mechanistic_justification: Tip-directed elongation is favored at low [Br-] where tip passivation is minimal.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: 20 nm (at 2 mM) up to 26 nm (at 50 mM)
observables.mechanistic_justification: Increased [Br-] redirects adatoms to lateral facets, thickening the waist.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: Sharpened/elongated tips with aspect ratio increasing to ~4.1
observables.mechanistic_justification: Preferential growth at the five-fold twinned apices at low bromide concentration accentuates tip sharpness.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: AuBPs stored in 10 mM CTAB undergo significant oxidative tip blunting and LSPR blue-shift over 30 days, whereas AuBPs in 10 mM CTAC retain their sharp tips and optical spectral profile.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: Blue-shift of 40 - 80 nm (from 900 nm down to 820 - 860 nm)
observables.mechanistic_justification: Dissolved oxygen in the presence of strong Au(I)-complexing Br- ligands drives spontaneous oxidative etching of the high-energy tips.
Cl- has a much lower complexation affinity for Au(I) than Br-, preventing dissolved-oxygen-mediated oxidative dissolution of tips.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: CTAB: increases from 3.0 nm to 6.0 - 8.0 nm; CTAC: remains 3.0 - 3.5 nm
observables.mechanistic_justification: High surface curvature at the tips makes them primary targets for oxidative truncation in CTAB, rounding the apex.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Pure CTAB supports high-yield anisotropic growth into sharp Au nanobipyramids, whereas pure CTAC completely suppresses high-yield bipyramidal elongation, yielding primarily isotropic/spherical nanoparticles and low-aspect-ratio byproducts.

observables.mechanistic_justification: Bromide counterions in CTAB strongly adsorb onto Au facets and stabilize Ag(I) underpotential deposition (UPD) layers, driving tip elongation. Pure CTAC lacks bromide, preventing tip-directed anisotropic growth and keeping plasmon resonance in the visible transverse range.
In the absence of Br-, the chloride bilayer allows isotropic Au(0) deposition across all facets. CTAB enables strong side-facet passivation and preferential axial addition at penta-twinned apices.
Pentatwinned seed templates undergo isotropic overgrowth or disintegration into irregular particles under pure CTAC/8-HQL conditions, whereas CTAB preserves and amplifies the pentatwinned symmetry.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Systematically increasing [CTAB] from 1 to 50 mM in 100 mM CTAC linearly/monotonically increases aspect ratio, particle length, and longitudinal LSPR while dramatically increasing reaction completion time.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: 670 nm (at 1 mM CTAB) to ~1060 nm (at 50 mM CTAB)
observables.mechanistic_justification: Increasing [CTAB] raises the Br-/Cl- surface exchange ratio, enhancing side-facet passivation and promoting extreme axial elongation.
Higher Br- surface coverage suppresses lateral growth on {110}/{100} side facets, directing reduced Au atoms strictly toward the penta-twinned {111} apex tips.
Equatorial growth is pinned by Ag-Br adlayer underpotential deposition across all bromide-containing conditions above 1 mM.
Length increases more than 2-fold while width remains constrained near 20 nm, resulting in a continuous increase in aspect ratio.
Geometrical volume of a dual pentagonal pyramid scales linearly with particle length at constant waist width.
Bromide binds more strongly to Au(I) than chloride, lowering the Au(I)/Au(0) reduction potential and significantly decelerating 8-HQL reduction kinetics.
Slower growth kinetics at elevated Br- levels allow thermodynamic minimization of tip surface energy, sharpening the apical tip geometry.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Inorganic KBr sweep in 100 mM CTAC exactly mimics the CTAB sweep: Br- counterion addition alone drives AuCl4- to AuBr4- ligand exchange, red-shifts LSPR, increases aspect ratio, and slows reaction kinetics identically.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: 670 nm (1 mM KBr) to ~1050 nm (50 mM KBr)
observables.mechanistic_justification: Anionic halide exchange on the micelle headgroup and the Au surface is purely governed by [Br-]/[Cl-] thermodynamics, decoupling the mechanism from the CTA+ surfactant chain concentration.
Bromide from KBr coordinates with Ag+ and Au+ to stabilize equatorial facets identically to bromide introduced via CTAB.
Waist diameter is governed by the critical seed nucleus size and Ag-UPD passivation threshold, remaining fixed despite increasing KBr.
Axial elongation dominates as Br- concentration increases at invariant particle waist width.
Length elongation at constant waist width directly drives the increase in unit volume per bipyramid.
Ligand exchange of [AuCl4]- to [AuBr4]- (confirmed spectrophotometrically by the shift in the LMCT absorption band from 395 nm to 400 nm) lowers precursor reduction potential.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: AgNO3 concentration exhibits a sharp threshold transition: below ~17-19 µM Ag+, bipyramid formation fails (spheres/rods dominate); above 19 µM, bipyramid shape yield exceeds 85-90% with stable LSPR.

observables.mechanistic_justification: A critical underpotential deposition (UPD) coverage of Ag(0)/Ag(I) on the lateral facets is required to arrest radial growth and direct pentatwinned seed growth exclusively along the 5-fold axis.
Without Ag+, lack of facet-specific growth arrest produces isotropic or poorly defined particles. Once the Ag threshold is reached, stable anisotropic bipyramid geometry is established.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: AR = 3.0 ± 0.2; Length = 55 - 62 nm; Width = 18 - 20 nm for 23 - 100 µM
observables.mechanistic_justification: Once monolayer/sub-monolayer Ag-UPD coverage is fully saturated on the side facets, additional AgNO3 in solution produces no further aspect ratio expansion.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Increasing seed concentration [Au0] (decreasing [HAuCl4]/[Au0] from 100 to 10) systematically downscales particle volume and linear dimensions by 10-fold while preserving an invariant aspect ratio and LSPR.

observables.mechanistic_justification: Total precursor gold is distributed over an increasingly large number of growing seeds, scaling particle mass/volume inversely with [Au0].
Cube-root volume scaling dictates a proportional reduction in length as total monomer per seed drops.
Waist width contracts proportionally with particle length to maintain self-similar geometric scaling.
Aspect ratio is governed strictly by the chemical growth environment (fixed [CTAB]=5 mM, [CTAC]=100 mM, [AgNO3]=30 µM), which enforces self-similar geometric expansion regardless of seed count.
In the quasi-static plasmonic regime, longitudinal LSPR is almost exclusively determined by aspect ratio and tip sharpness, both of which remain constant.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Co-varying [CTAB] and seed concentration enables decoupled control over AuBP volume (3,110 to 19,702 nm³) at strictly fixed LSPR (~750 nm and ~800 nm), with refractive index sensitivity (RIS) and FOM increasing significantly with volume.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: 670 nm (1 mM CTAB) to ~950 nm (25 mM CTAB)
observables.mechanistic_justification: Even at lower precursor-to-seed ratios, bromide counterions modulate the relative tip-to-waist growth rate, allowing fine-tuning of the aspect ratio.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: Pinned at 750 ± 10 nm (or 800 ± 10 nm) across 3,110 to 19,702 nm³
observables.mechanistic_justification: Adjusting [CTAB] slightly to maintain constant tip curvature and aspect ratio while modulating [Au0] allows the particle volume to be tuned by a factor of 6 at invariant resonance.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: RIS: ~160 nm/RIU (3,110 nm³) to ~390 nm/RIU (19,702 nm³); FOM increases from ~1.8 to ~3.8
observables.mechanistic_justification: Larger nanoparticles exhibit greater optical polarizability and spatial extension of the localized plasmonic near-field into the surrounding dielectric medium, significantly enhancing refractive index sensitivity.

series_predictions.predicted_summary: Secondary overgrowth of pre-formed AuBPs at low [CTAB] (2 mM) leads to waist thickening and tip blunting/dogbone formation, whereas high [CTAB] (≥10 mM) preserves sharp tip morphology and extends the aspect ratio and LSPR.

observables.predicted_quantitative_range: 760 nm (at 2 mM CTAB) to > 900 nm (at 50 mM CTAB)
observables.mechanistic_justification: Insufficient Br- at 2 mM allows premature isotropic deposition causing a blue-shift relative to initial seeds (795 nm), whereas high Br- forces preferential tip overgrowth, red-shifting the longitudinal mode.
Higher bromide concentrations direct incoming Au(0) exclusively onto the high-energy penta-twinned apex sites.

critiques.physical_chemistry_correction: In seeded growth using thermally aged pentatwinned seeds and 8-hydroxyquinoline (8-HQL) at 35 °C, pure CTAC provides the fast longitudinal growth along the 5-fold twin axis needed to produce elongated bipyramids. critiques.physical_chemistry_correction: By mass conservation, V ~ [HAuCl4]/[Au0] is constant across all 13 samples (~11,000 nm³), dictating a strict inverse geometric tradeoff between length and width (V ~ L * W²). Furthermore, Br- forms strongly bound CTA+/[AgBr2]- complexes on {112} high-index facets, which suppresses growth along the longitudinal twin boundary. Therefore, as [CTAB] increases from 1 to 50 mM: particle length DECREASES, particle width INCREASES, aspect ratio DECREASES, tip radius INCREASES (tips become blunter), and the longitudinal LSPR monotonically BLUESHIFTS (from the near-IR down to the visible/NIR boundary).
